_doc: Entries for packages/cf-schema (lands with PR #229, not on main yet). Apply when that package is on this branch: add to model-split.json and erasure-classification.json, then run `npm run generate -w @ebda/cf-schema` so the parity test sees eta_connections and eta_receipts. Ruling ETA-1.

EtaConnection.reason: storeId-scoped, read only in one store context; holds the merchant's encrypted ETA credentials

EtaReceipt.reason: storeId-scoped fiscal record, read and written in one store context (the submit job runs inside the store's scope)

store-do:eta_connections.note: secret credentials, destroyed on store close (the merchant revokes the POS in the ETA portal)

store-do:eta_receipts.note: tax record: the receipt document holds the buyer's first and last name and mobile (ETA buyer block); retained for the statutory period, then anonymised with the order. No customer id column; keyed by order_id

parity-exceptions.json: none needed: columns use only the standard Decimal/DateTime/Json/Boolean representations
